title: Radical notation
text: Radicals and fractional powers mean the same thing. Using powers makes it easier to apply exponent rules, and we have less formulas to remember!

title: Negative signs
text: Negative signs are easy to lose, but they’re part of math. When negatives appear, we just work with them carefully.

title: Multi-valued or undefined numbers
text: In calculus, we focus on exponential functions with a fixed base and changing power. These functions are key in calculus and many sciences. To keep them defined and single-valued, we need to add this restriction that the base be greater than zero!
